project_info.theme: Lip shade comparison for YSL The Slim
project_info.color_palette: Warm bronze gradient, soft beige skin tones, pink-red lipstick, deep ruby red lipstick

main_subject.detail: Extreme close-up of a female mouth with slightly parted lips and visible white teeth, split diagonally by a thin white divider line to compare two lipstick finishes. Top headline reads '#21 - ROUGE PARADOXE' and bottom copy reads 'ĐỎ RUBY QUYẾN RŨ'.
main_subject.style: Luxury beauty macro, clinical shade-comparison poster, matte lip texture focus

composition_elements.text: #21 - ROUGE PARADOXE, ĐỎ RUBY QUYẾN RŨ
items: Top Left: Warm bronze gradient header area
Top Right: Large bold white typography '#21 - ROUGE PARADOXE'
Bottom Left: Softer pink-red matte lip tone on the left half of the mouth
Bottom Right: Deeper ruby red matte lip tone on the right half of the mouth with more saturated contrast
Center/Background: Full-frame lip macro on fair skin with a thin diagonal white comparison line and large white footer text 'ĐỎ RUBY QUYẾN RŨ'

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even frontal illumination, crisp lip texture, smooth skin gradients, high-clarity cosmetic detail, no harsh shadows

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury beauty shade-comparison poster for YSL. Centerpiece is an extreme close-up of a female mouth with slightly parted lips and visible white teeth, divided by a thin diagonal white line to compare two matte lipstick tones. Left side is a softer pink-red matte finish, right side is a richer ruby red matte finish. Include the exact text '#21 - ROUGE PARADOXE' at the top and 'ĐỎ RUBY QUYẾN RŨ' at the bottom in bold white typography. Background is a warm bronze gradient field framing the lip macro. Technical style: photoreal beauty macro advertising composite, soft studio beauty lighting, crisp lip texture and smooth skin gradients, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
